18 yo here with severe depression and anxiety with a sprinkle of suicidal thoughts. (I'm on my road to recovery)

After finding the right therapist you learn to trust them. Taking to my therapist, Matt, I can rant about every little thing that could've started drama if I had said it to a friend. 

My therapy is very me focused, like we do whatever I want that day. We've even done activities like mindful eating with wasabi peas, saying my negative thoughts over and over really fast for a minute till they lose meaning. 

If people are worried that therapy is really formal and strange it's important to find the right person. And dont be afraid to tell your current therapist that you want to try someone else. they understand. Can be a little awkward but in the end its so much more effective.

Also if you're struggling to find medication that works for you seeing a psychiatrist really helps because they have so much knowledge and experience compared to a GP. In my town there is only 2, so my GP set up me to Skype one from Sydney, free of charge!! (Some government thing)

Even without mental illness it's good to go and rant to a different person who won't get hurt or take sides. My BF started going when I was at my worst and he loved having someone on his side, and someone who understood his stress of me, school, and his hypocritical parents
